title: Writer|LibreOffice|Без имени
pre: $v=((Get-Item 'C:\Program Files\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe').VersionInfo.ProductVersion -split '\.')[0..2] -join '.'; Log "LO version $v"; foreach($base in "https://download.documentfoundation.org/libreoffice/stable/$v","https://downloadarchive.documentfoundation.org/libreoffice/old/$v.0"){ try { $u="$base/win/x86_64/LibreOffice_${v}_Win_x86-64_langpack_ru.msi"; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -OutFile C:\demo\lp.msi -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Log "langpack from $u"; break } catch { Log "langpack fail $u" } }; if (Test-Path C:\demo\lp.msi) { Start-Process msiexec -ArgumentList '/i','C:\demo\lp.msi','/qn' -Wait; Log 'langpack installed' }

Start-Process 'C:\Program Files\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe' -ArgumentList '--headless','--terminate_after_init' -Wait; Start-Sleep 3; Get-Process soffice,soffice.bin -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep 3
